audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Shen Level 2, Levels 4-5, Level 6 and 2+ items, but whys[1] calls Cho'Gath's level-2 Rupture the earliest all-in threat in the lane, whys[4] says Feast shifts local kill threat to him, and whys[6] says the full-item solo lane is unwinnable. Packet levelChart and the audited Cho'Gath mirror both read Skill, Cho'Gath, Shen, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Shen, Skill.
audit.why: Rupture at a flat 6s is online before Shadow Dash; Feast's true damage bypasses Shen's whole HP identity at 6; Shen's windows are level 3 and his first item.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill; Level 2 Cho'Gath; Level 3 Shen; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 Cho'Gath; First item Shen; 2+ items Skill. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes cover Lvl 3, Lvl 6 Feast, first item and late Feast stacks, which is where the corrected chart changes hands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream's silence was only ever mentioned as a generic 'get silenced mid-combo' with filler text underneath, and the entry never states what the silence actually denies. Feast is true damage and percent-max-health, which the text does carry.
audit.why: Silenced, Shen cannot cast Shadow Dash or Stand United at all — that is what makes Feral Scream (11s at rank 1) the punish on your approach and on any R you try to fire in a skirmish.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the silence denies your R and E casts; dosFull[0].d carries Rupture's flat 6s; whys[3] rebuilt on the real Rupture and Feral Scream numbers.

audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6s at every rank, which is why the entry's 'engage in the Rupture window' advice is short and specific rather than a long gap.

edits.before: Cho'Gath can freeze or slow-push to deny Shen's engage angles and his base tank stats let him win short trades if Rupture clips first — the lane is even enough that Shen banks small leads rather than forcing kills.
edits.after: Cho'Gath can freeze to deny your engage angles, and with Rupture on a flat 6s and Feral Scream's silence up every 11s he wins any short trade that opens with a clipped knockup — bank CS, not kills.

edits.before: Telegraphed. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Flat 6s and telegraphed — dodge it, then dash in that gap.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Feral Scream silences — while it holds you cannot cast Shadow Dash or R.

notes: Agreeing with the Cho'Gath-side mirror: the kit file tags Rupture with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's description says it pops units into the air, so it is a knockup and I did not write anywhere that it grounds Shadow Dash. Both suspectNames here ('Use Stand United', "Stand United's") are false positives — the name is correct and the detector matched the leading word.
